people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.
translations.bsb: And Noah and his wife, with his sons and their wives, entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
translations.kjv: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
translations.asv: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
